correctness.rationale: Fresh descendant masks represented each coalition of at most three codewords exactly. Exhausting all 296010 six-subsets found 135 valid codes, while all 888030 seven-subsets failed; since separability is hereditary, no larger code exists. Applying every coordinate permutation and independent ternary symbol permutation to the 135 maxima gave exactly two orbits of sizes 27 and 108. The representative coordinate-multiplicity and pairwise-Hamming profiles independently distinguish those orbits.
